title: Deleting While Looping
story: remove_negatives() leaves some negative numbers behind.
goal: Diagnose the bug, then fix the code so every check passes.
hints: Run it on [-1, -2, -3] and watch which items are visited.
Instead of deleting, collect the numbers you want to keep.
socratic: What did you expect it to do?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?
alt:
def remove_negatives(nums):
    return [n for n in nums if n >= 0]

parrot.says: Squawk! I delete each negative as I find it. Same list, no waste!

diagnose.question: Why are some negatives skipped?
options: Removing items while looping shifts the list so the next item is skipped
diagnose.why: Changing a list while looping over it skips items. Build a new list instead.
